name: Colcannon (Scottish)
author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors

ingredients.item: Equal amounts of cooked potato and cabbage

steps: Melt a piece of butter in a saucepan, allowing approximately 1 ounce per 1 pound vegetables.
Mix all the ingredients together, heat thoroughly, and serve.

culture.text: Colcannon is a traditional Irish dish of mashed potatoes with cabbage. It is a popular dish on Saint Patrick's Day and on the feast day of St. Brigid.
